text_original: Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Consumer Reports states the CT5 has a dynamic ride and handling combination that should appeal to keen drivers. Consumer Reports states the powertrain lacks polish, which could deter shoppers in test-drive comparisons. Consumer Reports notes the CT5 is shorter than the CTS it replaced but has more interior room, and is slightly larger than its BMW 3 Series, Audi A4 and C-Class rivals. Original excerpt(s), from tool summaries: «a dynamic ride and handling combination» «its powertrain lacks polish»

Collector paraphrase (not verbatim source text): Reviewer describes the car as quick. Reviewer advises skipping the optional yoke because it compromises usability, maneuverability and comfort. Reviewer states newer rivals from legacy brands have more intuitive controls. Reviewer states newer rivals from legacy brands have nicer interiors. Reviewer cites one of the longest ranges among EVs (402 miles EPA). Reviewer notes public charging is easy. Reviewer cites the versatility of the hatchback body.
